title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta32

## Recorder write amplification and idle History retention

This beta addresses [#458](https://github.com/vahesoo/NaviMower/issues/458) without changing mower commands, polling schedules, location validation, gate safety, retained mowing route geometry, or the separately installed Map Card.

### Recorder efficiency
- Stop publishing ever-increasing per-source age counters as ordinary entity attributes (battery, task progress, latest notification, weather/status, mower, map metadata, current physical zone/channel, Custom Area, map snapshot, and other affected entities).
- Preserve authoritative freshness detection inside the coordinator, vendor/MQTT position gating and controlled automation state. Keep stateful flags such as `stale`, `fresh` and `mqtt_pose_valid`; keep useful countdowns unchanged.
- Keep age counters available in Home Assistant Download diagnostics, including new entries for session-area freshness, physical-zone position freshness and cached snapshot render age. Optional dedicated age diagnostics remain available; the MQTT pose-age entity is disabled by default for **new installations** (existing user enablement choices remain unchanged).
- Keep the Latest notification `recent` list live for Map Card/automations, but mark it unrecorded in Home Assistant Recorder. The Map data entity retains its full live metadata for the Map Card; its historical attribute payload is excluded from Recorder. Meaningful state transitions remain recorded.

### Local History retention
- Apply configured History retention daily even when mowing is idle for weeks, not only on startup, session completion or shutdown.
- Prune expired completed session files and their derived prepared History archives. Preserve active sessions and per-zone current-cycle VendorTrailStore, ZoneLedger and the separate HA Recorder history.
- Cleanup is scoped per mower/config entry; it is cancelled on unload and restored if an unload is rejected. Unlimited retention remains unlimited.

### Compatibility and validation
- Existing config entries and automation-facing entity IDs are unchanged.
- Numeric `*_age` **attributes** are deliberately removed from affected entities; use the remaining freshness flags, timestamps and Download diagnostics instead. Dedicated opt-in diagnostic age sensors are unchanged aside from their default-enabled policy on new registrations.
- Permanent regression tests cover attribute removal, Recorder exclusions, live Map Card metadata, cached diagnostics and retention lifecycle.
- #458 reports ~1.1 GB of attribute writes over 14.8 days while idle. Savings should be substantial, but actual reductions **must be measured** after deployment; this change does not delete old Recorder rows or change its retention configuration.
- Command-control field validation from beta31 is still pending.
